milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate within visual range of the loom block (at spawn-relative [6, 1, 1] inside the open oak stall) and face toward it, confirming they have located and observed it. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable visual range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the loom rather than just passing nearby.
